title: Reduction request
description: How to reduce an observing block, as read by numina from each document of a YAML file

id.description: Identifier of the observing block. A request without id applies to all the blocks

requirements.description: Values of the requirements of the recipe, by name. They override those of the observing block

pipeline.description: Pipeline of the DRP, overrides the pipeline of the observing block

profile.description: UUID of the instrument configuration, overrides the one selected from the images

mode.description: Reduce the block with this observing mode, instead of its own
